title: bazis-screen/1: spec/screens/<id>.yaml
description: A screen of the frontend: one primitive (list, card or form) over an entity of spec/product.yaml, its actions and the states it renders. The screen marks its elements with `data-bz` attributes: screen:<id>, state:<loading|empty|loaded|error|forbidden|not_found|invalid>, list:<entity>, row:<id>, field:<field>, error:<field>, action:<id>, transit:<id>, status:<id>, nav:<screen>. The required states of a primitive: list loading, empty, error, forbidden; card loading, error, forbidden, not_found; form loading, error, forbidden, invalid.

id.description: The id of the screen, also the name of its file.

route.description: The route of the screen in the frontend; `:id` is the id of the item.

entity.description: The id of an entity of spec/product.yaml.

roles.description: The roles that see the screen in the navigation and use it in the scenarios; the backend decides the access.

filters.description: Fields that the contract can filter by.

sort.description: The default order: fields that the contract can sort by, `-` for descending.

open.description: The card screen that a row opens.

edit.description: The item is edited on the card, by the update form of its runtime schema.

transitions.description: The transits of the item (its workflow).

history.description: The status history of the item (its workflow).

fields.description: The fields of the form; all the writable fields of its runtime schema when omitted.

then.description: The screen shown after a submit.

action.description: `form`: a form of the entity (create on a list or a card, update on a card); `destroy`: the deletion of the item of a card.

then.description: The screen shown after the action.
